annotations.title: Find students whose plan period ends soon

description: Students with an active plan whose current period ends within the next days (default 7, up to 60), with name, phone (the guardian's for a dependent), plan title, period_end, days_left, renews_automatically (false when auto-renew is off or billing is manual, so the student will not be charged again unless the trainer acts) and app_url of the student profile. Plans that do not renew by themselves come first, then the ones ending sooner. Works for any plan, including monthly ones without a class count (list_packages_to_renew only sees class packages). Use it to answer "whose plan ends this week and will not renew by itself?" then get_student or list_student_subscriptions for one of them. Read only: nothing is renewed, charged or sent.

days.description: Look-ahead window in days, 0 to 60. Default 7.

name: list_plans_ending
